name: @commandgovernor/claude-acp
description: Claude on the user's subscription inside Prime Agent: a thin ACP client that drives the official claude-agent-acp adapter, so Claude Code owns its session, transcript, compaction and prompt-cache lineage.

$comment: The one piece of production code in this distribution, and ADR 0011 says
why it exists: Prime 0.9.1 ships an ACP *server* and no client, so nothing
already published can drive another ACP agent from inside Prime.
It has no runtime dependencies on purpose. Prime exposes only its own pi-*
and typebox modules to extensions, so an ACP SDK import would need a
node_modules tree of its own; the wire surface used here is four requests,
one notification and two inbound request kinds.
The adapter it drives is pinned separately in pins/pins.json and installed
by scripts/bootstrap.sh; this package resolves it, never vendors it.
